jobs.label: Dirt floor · step 1
jobs.description: Soft foot contact extracted from a natural walking passage.

body.text: Quiet natural footsteps on a dry compacted dirt floor. A person walks slowly and gently in soft leather shoes. Soft subdued soil contact and delicate short scuffs, an ordinary relaxed walk. Dry close recording, quiet background.
